subject: English
question_text: Use capitals and punctuation marks where necessary in the following text:
stimulus: once upon a time in venice italy there was a very rich merchant named antonio he had many ships that sailed in the sea his ship carried different types of merchandise to other countries. Part B : Composition (40 Marks)
guide_solution: Once upon a time in Venice, Italy, there was a very rich merchant named Antonio. He had many ships that sailed in the sea. His ship carried different types of merchandise to other countries.
